$comment: Which tests the Windows and macOS legs of the paddock-dev job run (OS-scoped tests, docs/research/2026-11-22-os-scoped-tests.md; ADR 0117 section 7; src/host_tests.rs; conformance C155). paddock-dev is one crate, so the placement is by test-name prefix (module). It is derived from the code (src/os_placement.rs: an OS cfg, an OS-API crate, an entry point of the portable layer, build.rs, env::consts::OS, an OS-behaviour dependency, and the import edge from a host module to the module it calls); only the exceptions, each with a reason, are declared here. `add` is free: code the derivation cannot see (host-runner production code with no OS signal of its own). `only` and `skip` take a host away and need the user (C155 compares them with the merge base): the agent tools of the dev Mac stay macOS-only. Everything else (the planner and its recorded answers, the conformance checks, the gate register, the CI run readers) is portable and tested on Linux only.
